title: SoA2USDM Activity Inventory Schema
description: activities.json of a collection: one entry per unified activity of each protocol's consolidated SoA, with its source-table occurrences and the annotations bound to it. For searching activities across a collection's protocols; no cross-protocol clustering.

schema_version.description: Schema version. 2.0 is the consolidated-only inventory (2026-09-30): the source-table rows of the earlier, unversioned 1.0 shape were removed. 2.1 adds document_references on an annotation; files stamped 2.0 remain valid.

protocols.description: Number of protocols in the inventory.

multi_table_activities.description: Activities found in more than one table.

activities_with_wording_variants.description: Activities with more than one verbatim wording across their tables.

protocol_id.description: Protocol the activity belongs to (e.g., NCT number).

sponsor.description: Sponsor as given in the collection's study list; empty when not given.

d4k_folder.description: Folder name of the study as given in the collection's study list; empty when not given.

therapeutic_area.description: Therapeutic area as given in the collection's study list; empty when not given.

xact_id.description: Unified activity id in the protocol's consolidated file.

activity_name.description: Canonical activity name in the protocol's consolidated file.

parent_name.description: Name of the parent activity; empty for a top-level activity.

hierarchy_level.description: Hierarchy level: 0 = section header/top-level, 1 = child, 2 = grandchild, etc.

is_section_header.description: True if this is a grouping header without schedule data.

is_redacted.description: True if any source row's activity name is a redaction placeholder ('CCI').

match_status.description: How consolidation matched the activity across tables (as in soa-tables-consolidated).

table_count.description: Number of tables this activity appears in.

tables.description: Table numbers the activity occurs in.

any_marks.description: True when any occurrence carries schedule data.

variants.description: Verbatim wordings of the activity across its tables.

track_label.description: Population/phase track label for track tables. null for non-track tables.

row_position.description: Physical row position of the row in that table.

verbatim_name.description: The activity name as worded in that table.

has_schedule_data.description: True when the row carries schedule data in that table.

occurrences.description: The source-table rows of the activity, one entry per row.

marker.description: Annotation marker in the source table.

columns.description: Present for an annotation bound to a mark: the header values of the column(s) it binds to.

document_references.description: Numbered targets in the protocol document that the annotation text points at, as stated in the resolved table. Present only when there is one. From 2.1.

kind.description: Kind of target the text names.

target.description: Its number or letter as printed

annotations.description: The annotations bound to the activity.

activities.description: One entry per unified activity of each protocol.
